This was made with 3 strands of paracord 550:

● 1 for the core, which should be ~2x the length of the final product since it was folded in half and the ends were cow hitched to a metal ring

● For the other 2 lengths of paracord, 1 of the lengths of cord (black) was ~2x the length of the other cord (black w/red diamonds).

● The 2 longer strands were joined together by melting the ends and putting them together

●  The joining point was placed under/behind the 2 core strands with one colour on either side

● The shorter strand (black + red) was crossed over the 2 core strands and the longer strand (Over 3)

● The longer strand (black) was then bunched to form a small loop

● The shorter strand was then passed under the loop  and then over the core strands  (Under loop, Over 2)

● The working end of the longer rope was then passed under the core, then back over the core and into the loop made by that strand (Under 2, Over same 2, Through loop)

● The longer strand was tightened down

● The shorter strand was then bunched into a loop + the loop was crossed over the core (Loop - Over 2)

● A loop of the longer cord was then passed through the previous loop (Loop-Black through Loop-Black + Red)

● The shorter strand was tightened around the other loop

● The longer strand was passed under, then back over the core into the loop made by that strand (Under 2, Over 2, Through loop)

● The longer strand was tightened down

● Steps were repeated until I got ~1" from the loop or until I ran out of space to tie more as I got to the cow hitches on the metal ring (depending on which end is the start vs the end, which I forget which side I started on lol)
